 Rainfall to continue today and for the next five days, NCM expects
 Last updated: October 28, 2026 | 12:53
 Picture used for illustrative purpose only. File 
 Mohammed Abu Al Samen, Staff Reporter 
 The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) expects rain to continue across the country’s northern, eastern, and southern parts today, Wednesday, and over the next five days.
 Wednesday’s weather will be fair to partly cloudy, with humid conditions in some coastal and inland areas during the morning and a chance of fog or mist. Convective clouds may develop in the north, east, and south, bringing rainfall.
 The winds will be southeasterly to northwesterly, remaining light to moderate but occasionally becoming fresh to strong, particularly near clouds, and raising dust. Wind speeds will range from 10 to 25 km/h, reaching up to 50 km/h. Sea conditions will be slight in both the Arabian Gulf and the Sea of Oman.
 On Thursday, conditions will remain fair to partly cloudy, with morning humidity in some coastal and inland areas and a chance of fog or mist. Convective clouds may form over the northern and eastern areas, potentially extending into some inland areas and bringing rain. Southeasterly to northeasterly winds will be light to moderate, occasionally becoming fresh to strong near clouds and raising dust. Speeds will range from 10 to 25 km/h, reaching up to 50 km/h. Seas will remain slight in the Arabian Gulf and the Sea of Oman.
 Friday will be fair to partly cloudy, with humid conditions in some coastal and inland areas during the morning and a possibility of light fog. Convective clouds may develop in the east, accompanied by rainfall. Southeasterly to northeasterly winds will be light to moderate, occasionally freshening near clouds and stirring up dust. Wind speeds will range from 10 to 25 km/h, reaching up to 40 km/h. Seas will be calm in both the Arabian Gulf and the Sea of Oman.
 On Saturday, the NCM forecasts fair to partly cloudy weather, with morning humidity in some coastal and inland areas, particularly in the west, and a possibility of light fog. Convective clouds are expected to form in the east during the afternoon, bringing rainfall. Southeasterly to northeasterly winds will be light to moderate, occasionally freshening with cloud activity and raising dust. Speeds will range from 10 to 25 km/h, reaching up to 40 km/h. Seas will remain calm in the Arabian Gulf and the Sea of Oman.
 Sunday’s weather will be fair to partly cloudy, with humid conditions in some coastal and inland areas during the morning. Convective clouds may form in the east during the afternoon, accompanied by rainfall. Southeasterly to northeasterly winds will be light to moderate, occasionally freshening near clouds and stirring up dust. Wind speeds will range from 10 to 25 km/h, reaching up to 40 km/h. Seas will be calm in both the Arabian Gulf and the Sea of Oman.
